jobs.description: Silver refresh of the 용도지역지구 도형 lane `land-use-zone-area` (root ADR-0169 ③, ADR-0362): pick the newest vintage whose AL_D<layer>_00 shapefiles cover every layer the lane contract lists, read from the ZIP members measured beside the Bronze ledger, and, unless silver.land_use_zone_area already records it or a newer one (`unchanged`), export each layer (geometry reprojected to EPSG:4326 WKB), stage the release on a load branch, compare it with the table's current rows one layer (compare bucket) at a time and append to main only the changed areas' rows and a removal marker per vanished area (lane contract compare.content_columns; root ADR-0311, ADR-0318), and read it back (`changed`). A run that reaches its time limit leaves the layers it did not compare to the next run. Started when a source_sweep run lands new files, and daily as the fallback (root ADR-0171). One lane runs at a time: each takes the compose `spark` cap.

expected_outcome.basis: Bronze land use zones are collected daily; measured 2026-11-11 from each unit's journal, 10-12..11-11 (read-only): the Silver lane changed once. A month and a day without one is a lane that stopped.

assets.title: 용도지역지구 구역
assets.description: 브이월드 용도지역지구 도형(NA/24) 중 처음 서빙하는 15개 층(개발제한구역·도시계획시설 7종·공장설립제한/승인지역·산업집적 용도구역·농업진흥지역·도시/농림/자연환경보전지역)의 구역과 EPSG:4326 도형(루트 ADR-0362). 판이 오면 층마다 바뀐 구역의 행만 덧붙인다. 필지별 저촉은 필지별 토지이용계획이 가진다.

dependencies.description: 전체데이터 AL_D<층>_00 SHP 의 목록 층만 연결한다. 변동데이터 CH_D* 와 목록 밖 172개 층은 Bronze 에 남는다.
